text:
Nina G: hey team — heads up: i'm planning to relocate to Sicily (Catania) for ~4 months starting Jun 15 to support a family obligation. can i stay on US payroll? does the monthly WFH stipend keep paying? will this trigger any tax nexus or benefits changes for me or the company? :wave:

Alexa P (People Ops): thanks for the heads-up, nina. short answer: probably yes for the stipend, but payroll/benefits and company exposure depend on duration and local rules. we need a bit more info (visa/status, exact dates, will you be working hours overlapping EU timezones?). can you fill the remote-work request form? https://redwood.internal/hr/remote-request (put placeholder)

Nina G: i'm a US citizen, no local employment in italy, spouse on a short student visa. i'll keep US hours ~9a-5p PT, no plans to onboard locals or travel for work on behalf of the company. i'll fill the form today. thanks.

Jamal R (Payroll): quick notes from payroll side: our global payroll partner supports short-term remote stints in italy but there are a few caveats. 1) personal tax residency rules vary — often a 183-day rule can matter, but italy also has specific residency/tax rules; 2) if you're only there ~4 months we typically can keep you on US payroll, but we need formal sign-off and a country review; 3) WFH stipend is usually pro-rated by payroll cycle and can continue while you're on US payroll — we'll confirm amounts after the form. please attach flight/addresses where possible.

Claire L (Legal): adding legal — action items: we'll run a company exposure check for italy (permanent establishment/tax nexus) and confirm whether any registration is required. based on similar cases, a single headcount remote for <6 months rarely creates nexus, but it's fact-dependent. we'll escalate to our tax counsel if there's customer-facing travel or local hiring.

Alexa P (People Ops): action plan: nina, fill the remote-work request + attach start/end dates and local address. jamal/claire — i'll open an internal case and tag tax/payroll. hr-bot will create the ticket and drop due dates.

hr-bot: New case created: HR-2026-842. Assigned to: Jamal R, Claire L, Alexa P. Due: 2026-05-08. Add docs to the case thread.

Nina G: filed the form and attached tentative lease + travel dates. thanks all.

Jamal R (Payroll): got it — i'll run payroll partner check this afternoon and post a quick summary here. if we need to pause stipend or change benefits enrollment windows we'll flag it.

Claire L (Legal): i'll run the nexus checklist and confirm whether we need to notify finance/tax counsel. expect update in 48 hours.

Alexa P (People Ops): thanks — one more note on benefits: global medical coverage varies by country. if you remain on US benefits and are out of country for routine care, coverage may be limited — please check the benefits FAQ after the case is updated.

Nina G: appreciate it. tagging @jamal-r for anything i missed. :handshake:

Jamal R (Payroll): thanks — quick FYI to everyone: if at any point nina extends beyond the initial 4 months we should re-evaluate immediately (possible local payroll or tax filings). otherwise sounds straightforward.

Alexa P (People Ops): closing loop: i'll post the final sign-off in HR-2026-842 once payroll & legal confirm. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
